title: CashGuard merchant catalogue (backend/data/merchants.json)
description: Romanian merchants for normalisation (C2), the seed (B12) and the persona generator (E12). Aliases are lower-case spellings seen on bank statements, without store numbers, cities or payment prefixes (C2 strips those); across merchants they are unique under the strictest key: app.i18n.text.fold, then letters and digits only (tests/unit/test_data_merchants.py). Load it strictly: plain json.load keeps the last of duplicate keys and returns floats, so parse numbers as Decimal and reject duplicate keys and NaN / Infinity, as tests/unit/datafiles.py parse_json does.

id.description: Stable slug: the merchants primary key and merchant_id everywhere (D47).

canonical_name.description: The display name, with correct Romanian diacritics.

aliases.description: Spellings C2 matches (longest alias wins); the folded canonical name is one of them.

mcc.description: ISO 18245 merchant category code: 4 digits, as text (codes can start with 0).

typical_basket.description: A fictional typical single purchase for one adult at this merchant, in RON, 2 decimals.

multi_category.description: true when item detail matters (D32): without items the question asks what was bought.
